# The Trail Watch Bounty

*Skarra pays the trail watch's bounty to anyone who keeps the roads clear: 50 of the roads' monsters, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) |
| Level | 15 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 50 Road monsters ([Dust Boggle](../monsters/dust_boggle.md), [Ridge Stump](../monsters/ridge_stump.md), [Edge Lizard](../monsters/edge_lizard.md), [Snapping Lizard](../monsters/snapping_lizard.md))

## Rewards

- 2,000 EXP
- 300 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 2,600 EXP, 600 mesos, [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md)

    - Good. You do not need to tell me where. The road will tell me.
